_comment: Deterministic word-level corrections applied to every Albanian string sent to the citizen. Entries are case-INSENSITIVE, whole-word matches. Case of the output mirrors the input (first letter preserves capitalisation). Add a rule ONLY when you see a recurring error in a real response — speculation belongs in ALBANIAN_LANGUAGE_RULES, not here.
_format: wrong: correct — wrong is the incorrect form the model produced; correct is the shqipe standarde form. Both single tokens, no spaces (for multi-word corrections, use phrases section below).
_phrases_comment: Multi-word corrections. Applied as whole-phrase case-insensitive replacements BEFORE the single-word pass.
